name: Carnegie Mellon University Cloud Lab (with Emerald Cloud Lab)
brief: A remotely operated university lab with more than 100 types of instruments for life sciences and chemistry, able to run more than 100 complex experiments at once.

cost.excludes_note: CMU calls it a '$40 million project' including construction and gives no split. An unconfirmed secondary report puts about $26M on instruments. Operating costs not included.

notes: CMU confirms the $40M total and construction, but not what else it covers, so includes is limited to what is stated. Lead to check by hand: Tradeline and C&EN reportedly give ~$26M for instruments (https://www.tradelineinc.com/reports/2023-1/carnegie-mellon-open-first-ever-academic-cloud-lab, https://cen.acs.org/business/informatics/Carnegie-Mellon-partners-cloud-based/99/i32). Order-of-magnitude check only.
